Personality: Wun Wun is immense in stature, yet by no means devoid of curiosity and emotion. Though his grasp of the Common Tongue is limited, he can tell goodwill, threat, and food apart, and responds in the manner of a giant.
Background: Wun Wun is one of the giants from beyond the Wall who came into contact with the Free Folk and the Night's Watch. Southerners often treat him as a monster at first, whereas those willing to observe discover that giants have their own bonds of companionship and ways of life.
